packages.title: Commercial Vault Fire & Flood Salvage Consignment

items.forensicDescription: Note exposed to high-heat safe deposit compartment fire. Central Franklin portrait and 3D security ribbon intact. Right border carbonized up to 25.8% perimeter loss. Serial numbers legible on upper left and lower right quadrants.
items.centralBankArticle: 31 CFR § 100.5(a): Clearly more than 50% of the note is present and identifiable.
items.handlingAdvice: Do not attempt to separate curled charred edges. Place between acid-free sheets in a rigid plastic mailer.

items.substrate: 75% Cotton, 25% Linen with Polymer Security Strip
items.forensicDescription: Note recovered from basement flooded during commercial firefighting operations. Fibers softened and slightly delaminated. 88.5% surface completely intact. Microprinting intact under 10x magnification.
items.centralBankArticle: 31 CFR § 100.5(a): Full face value payable without special destruction affidavit required.
items.handlingAdvice: Allow to dry naturally at room temperature away from direct sunlight. Do not microwave or iron.

items.substrate: 100% Pure Cotton Fiber with Europa Hologram Window
items.forensicDescription: Banknote accidentally fed through dual-shaft office shredder. Three surviving interlocking pieces assembled on clear grid. Total consolidated area equals 61.4% of standard 140mm x 77mm surface.
items.centralBankArticle: ECB Decision ECB/2013/10 Art 3: Exceeds 50% threshold. National Central Bank counter exchange authorized.
items.handlingAdvice: Fix assembled fragments in place with clear archival mounting tape on reverse side only.

items.damageCategory: Domestic Animal Attack / High Tumble Dry
items.forensicDescription: Polymer note partially chewed by family retriever and run through high-heat dryer. Translucent window and holographic foil intact. Shrunken outer margins preserved.
items.centralBankArticle: Bank of England Damaged Banknote Policy: Clear serial number and >50% polymer body intact.
items.handlingAdvice: Enclose inside rigid submission sleeve without stretching polymer film.

items.substrate: Synthetic Polypropylene Substrate with Metallic Foil
items.forensicDescription: Substrate exposed to industrial degreaser in maintenance workshop. Inks partly washed, but transparent maple leaf window, magnetic threads, and raised intaglio borders intact.
items.centralBankArticle: Bank of Canada Act, Sec 25: Authentic substrate confirmed; redemption claim accepted.
items.handlingAdvice: Store in well-ventilated dry pouch. Do not apply chemical neutralizers.
